brief: Prioritise the asset for pre-event attention because units of advanced age with a history of high loading have a reduced margin against mechanical failure under thermal cycling, as outlined in MG-023. If the unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure, in accordance with MG-023. Outstanding work should also be re-prioritised against its effect on the unit's ability to shed heat as governed by SOP-016.
